title: The funny thing is that Tsitsipas actually isn't a great representative of the single hander. He has always had all of its weaknesses and few of its traditional strengths (natural slice, block return feel, backhand drop shot feel, options on lower balls et al). The single hander is going extinct more broadly at the top of the men's tour for plenty of reasons though, one of them being that the game is too fast and powerful for the shot. title:
The Serena-Capriati rivalry was so good. A few notable things...

- they played 7 times at majors, but never a final
- those matches were compressed into a 3-year span
- 6 of those 7 matches went the full 3 sets
- Capriati a rare player with a winning H2H vs Serena at Slams (4-3)
